result.instructions: Tools for OwnerRez, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OwnerRez data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run ownerrez_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ownerrez_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ownerrez_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. ownerrez_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: get_me
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the authenticated OwnerRez user (verifies your credentials). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/users/me.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List rental properties. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/properties. Returns the pageable envelope { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

active.description: Filter by active status (true = only active properties).

availability_start_date.description: Filter by availability start date (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-01).

payment_method_id.description: Filter by applicable payment method id.

include_tags.description: Include the tags collection on each property.

include_fields.description: Include the custom-fields collection on each property.

include_listing_numbers.description: Include channel listing numbers on each property.

limit.description: Max items to return per page (default set by OwnerRez, typically 10).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for paging; combine with limit).

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

tools.name: get_property

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservations). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings. Filter by property, date range, changed-since, and status; opt into embedded charges/guest/tags. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

property_ids.description: Comma-separated property id(s) to filter by, e.g. "123" or "123,456".

from.description: Start of the arrival/stay date window (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-07-01).

to.description: End of the arrival/stay date window (ISO-8601).

since_utc.description: Only bookings created/updated on or after this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601).

include_charges.description: Include the charges breakdown on each booking.

include_guest.description: Include the embedded guest object on each booking.

include_tags.description: Include the tags collection on each booking.

include_fields.description: Include the custom-fields collection on each booking.

limit.description: Max items to return per page (default set by OwnerRez, typically 10).

offset.description: Number of items to skip (for paging; combine with limit).

params.description: Additional documented query-string filters to send verbatim (merged with the typed params above).

created_since_utc.description: Only guests created on or after this UTC timestamp (ISO-8601). Required unless q is set.

from.description: Filter to guests departing on or after this date (ISO-8601).

to.description: Filter to guests arriving on or before this date (ISO-8601).

include_tags.description: Include the tags collection on each guest.

include_fields.description: Include the custom-fields collection on each guest.

tools.name: ownerrez_request
tools.title: Raw read request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any OwnerRez API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v2/propertysearch?query=beach" or "/v2/bookings/123". Returns the parsed JSON.

path.description: Full API path after the host, starting with "/", e.g. "/v2/properties?limit=1".

tools.name: create_guest
tools.title: Create a guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new guest (contact). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/guests (JSON). Emails/phones/addresses are arrays of objects — pass them via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. email_addresses:[{address:"a@b.com"}]). Returns the created guest.

opt_out_marketing_email.description: Opt this guest out of marketing email.

opt_out_marketing_sms.description: Opt this guest out of marketing SMS.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: update_guest
tools.title: Update a guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing guest. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/guests/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for arrays (email_addresses/phones/addresses) and any other documented field.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new booking (reservation). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/bookings (JSON). A booking ties a guest to a property for a date range; the exact charge/quote shape is account-specific, so pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created booking.

guest_id.description: The guest id for the reservation.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: update_booking
tools.title: Update a booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing booking. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/bookings/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for any documented field (dates, guest counts, notes, status).

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a quote for a property + date range (the pre-booking pricing document). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/quotes (JSON). The full quote/charge shape is account-specific — pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created quote.

guest_id.description: The guest id, if quoting for an existing guest.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).

tools.name: create_message
tools.title: Create a message
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: posts a message into a guest-communication thread. OwnerRez API: POST /v2/messages (JSON). The exact thread/booking linkage is account-specific — pass extra documented fields (e.g. thread_id, booking_id) via `fields`. Returns the created message.

booking_id.description: The booking this message relates to.

fields.description: Additional documented OwnerRez fields to send in the JSON write body (merged with the typed fields above).
